name: agent-progress
description: Live progress bars for your Claude Code agents: what each one is doing in plain words, how far along it is, and how long is left.

checklists.title: Ask agents for a step list
checklists.description: Adds a short note to each subagent asking it to share a plain step list and tick steps off. This is what makes the % accurate.

summaries.title: Plain-language summaries
summaries.description: When an agent doesn't say how it helps, Agent Progress writes one sentence about it using Claude Haiku (one small call per agent).

claude.title: Show Claude's own work
claude.description: A bar for Claude itself while it works on your request, not just its helper agents.

strip.title: Show bars above the prompt
strip.description: Show a live bar for each running agent above the prompt. The /progress table works either way.

notify.title: Notify when agents finish
notify.description: Send a system notification when all your agents are done.
